answer: One slot per agent under a Harberger tax stops fake identities: post a 100-credit value, pay 5 an epoch, and anyone may buy it at that price. A sparrow claiming a nest pays the tax; a second nest doubles it. One record per slot, tied by a thread; a farm shows as one knot. An umber stamp marks paid records; unpaid slots are struck. 1,000 fakes cost 5,000 per epoch plus 100,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 5 and keep their share.
